Reachable keeps the content of a declarative shadow root

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["hiddenContent" => "Reachable"]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<div><template shadowrootmode=\"open\"><p>shadow body</p></template><span>light body</span></div>", $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
